lib.name: Lock the screen
lib.desc: Locks the session. The user signs back in as usual.
lib.impact: 1 person is locked out until they sign back in.

lib.name: Show a message
lib.desc: Puts a message on the user's screen until they dismiss it.
lib.impact: 1 person sees the message straight away.

lib.name: Notify a person
lib.desc: Tells an Admin, or you, inside the console.

lib.name: Restart the machine
lib.desc: Warns the user, waits 2 minutes, then restarts.
lib.impact: 1 machine restart. Unsaved work is lost if the warning is ignored.

lib.name: Take a screenshot
lib.desc: Saves what is on screen to the record.
lib.impact: Users are not interrupted. The screenshot is kept in the record.

lib.name: Snapshot USB contents
lib.desc: Lists every file on an inserted device, with its hash.
lib.impact: Only machines with a USB device inserted return anything.

lib.name: List running programs
lib.desc: Every process, with its memory and open files.

lib.name: Check disk health
lib.desc: Reads SMART status and free space.
lib.impact: Users are not interrupted. Takes about 10 seconds.

lib.name: Log event
lib.desc: Writes one line to the audit log.

lib.name: Clear the temp folder
lib.desc: Deletes files older than 7 days in %TEMP%.
lib.impact: Old temporary files are deleted on 1 machine. Files in use are skipped.
lib.script:
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

LIMIT_DAYS = 7
temp = Path(os.environ["TEMP"])
cutoff = time.time() - LIMIT_DAYS * 86400
removed = 0
for f in temp.rglob("*"):
    try:
        if f.is_file() and f.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
            f.unlink()
            removed += 1
    except OSError:
        pass  # in use; try again next time
print(f"removed {removed} files")

lib.name: Map the shared drive
lib.desc: Maps \\fileserver\common as S: if it is missing.
lib.impact: Adds drive S: where it is missing. Nothing is removed.
